root_cause: The required PR check runs a curated test list. Tests that read a changed page or file ran only in the post-merge backend lane, so PR #5447 turned main red (run 42039250029) after merge.
prevention_rule: The required PR check also runs every existing test that references a changed file by its exact repo path, plus changed test files. A test that already fails on the base commit is reported as KNOWN_RED_ON_BASE and does not block; a new failure blocks. Overflow beyond 40 tests fails visibly.
